A considered finishing touch

Style this border at the top of the vertical wall, directly below the ceiling or existing cornice. It is a flat printed wall border; no physical skirting or moulding is included. Each design comes in one fixed colour composition and standard pack.

Suitable wall preparation and installation depend on the painted surface. Ask us to confirm compatibility and the installation instructions for your room before ordering.
